lines: Backstop off. It stops a driver whose line falls under -$550.
Glide starts Sun 9:00am CT: limit slides from -$550 to $0 by Sun 1:00pm CT.
Under the limit it trims rows, buys back cheaply, and sells to close gaps from Sun 11:30am CT.
Even-up from Sun 12:00pm CT, last-resort take from Sun 12:40pm CT, green flag Sun 1:00pm CT.
